concept: Multi-Token Prediction Heads and Speculative Decoding
summary: Source-anchored research for Multi-Token Prediction Heads and Speculative Decoding. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: On memory-bandwidth-bound local hardware like Apple Silicon M5 Max, speculative decoding and MTP boost effective generation throughput by 20% to 40% without modifying output token probabilities. (high confidence)

Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) generates candidate future tokens in parallel and verifies them in a single transformer forward pass, amortizing weight memory reads across multiple accepted tokens. (high confidence)
